title: Laboratory LOINC, 1,000 per page, designations in every language
why: Slow-ish: up to ~20 language variants x several name kinds per code.
stresses: 1,000 rows x ~15-40 designations; the largest response in the catalog

expectedDifferences.reason: tx.fhir.org serves 12 LOINC languages (no zh-CN, it-IT, el-GR, ru-RU, es-ES, et-EE, pl-PL, tr-TR, fr-BE, fr-CA) and adds the Uzbek lang-pack supplement unasked; our LOINC 2.83 import has all 20 release languages.
